name: Higan Shinjuu Fractal
source:
The beginning of Taisho era. The Kashima family mansion burns down with owner, wife and six servants inside. Hard evidence on criminal is not found.
Three years later interviewer girl takes this case personally and starts investigation with new energy.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
大正时代初期。

鹿岛家宅邸被大火烧毁，屋主、妻子和六名佣人全部葬身其中。警方没有找到足以指认罪犯的确凿证据。

三年后，一名女记者决定亲自调查此案，并以全新的热情展开追查。

[来自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
